resources/fa-pairs.bin (Persian word-pair statistics) is derived from
Persian Wikipedia.

Source text: the Persian Wikipedia dump of 2018-10-01 (fawiki-20181001),
as plain text in https://github.com/Text-Mining/Persian-Wikipedia-Corpus
(commit b3e157ce7fcc2f310dc5c23bf33a1883597714cb).

Wikipedia text is (c) Wikipedia contributors and is available under the
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

The file holds no text from Wikipedia: only hashes of word pairs and, for
each, how much more often the two words appear next to each other than
chance would predict. These derived statistics are distributed under the
same license, CC BY-SA 3.0. They are rebuilt with tools/count_word_pairs.py
and tools/generate_pair_table.py (see docs/SPELLING.md).
